Navigate to the recruitment or online application section.

important_instructions: The position is purely on a contractual basis up to 31st March 2027, but likely to be extended subject to performance and requirement. content_sections.text: Visit the official NHSRC website at http://nhsrcindia.org. Navigate to the recruitment or online application section. Fill in the online application correctly in the prescribed online application format. Attach the consultant's recent CV and evidence of last consultancy payment received. Submit the application before the last date of 27-Oct-2026.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Finance Controller Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely on a contractual basis up to 31st March 2027, but likely to be extended subject to performance and requirement. The first three months will be on probation basis. The consultant should be ready to travel extensively to State/District/Block/village levels. The consultancy can be terminated by either party by giving a notice of one month in writing. If the recruitment process includes a written test, a minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for 1 Finance Controller post under the NHM Finance Division of MoHFW on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Finance Controller post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 27-Oct-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBA (Finance)/CA/PGDBM (Finance)/PGDBA (Finance) from a recognized University/Institute with at least 6 years of experience in financial management operations and related fields.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be up to 60 years of age on the last date of submitting the application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to fill in the online application correctly on the NHSRC website at http://nhsrcindia.org.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is in the fee range of Rs. 90,000 – Rs. 1,50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The contract is initially up to 31st March 2027 and is likely to be extended subject to performance and requirements.

faq.question: Q10. What are the minimum qualifying marks for the written test?
faq.answer: If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.
